## Current role
- FleetX (Norwegian TMS, transportation management SaaS), Jan 2026 — present
- Designed and built per-shipment emissions calculation (CO2e, NOx, PM, CO, HC), following GLEC v3.2 and aligned with ISO 14083, with factors traceable to their published sources
- Built route profitability calculations combining fuel consumption, driver salary and overtime, using exact decimal arithmetic and transactions
- Built the driver timesheet end to end: Laravel backend, Vue approval dashboard and an offline-capable Flutter app connected to tachograph data and payroll
